data.one_liner: Parse, format, validate and extract international phone numbers in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to parse raw phone strings into structured objects, format them in various standards, and validate their correctness. It also offers utilities like type detection, example generation, geocoding, carrier lookup, and as‑you‑type formatting.
use_when: You need phone‑number handling without native platform code
Cross‑platform Flutter apps require consistent validation and formatting
avoid_when: You need deep integration with native telephony APIs
You require a full‑featured contact management solution
strengths: Pure Dart implementation works on all Flutter platforms
Comprehensive feature set covering parsing, formatting, validation, and metadata
weaknesses: Relies on bundled metadata which may become outdated between releases
Limited to phone‑number utilities; no broader validation library
